business_summary: UTI Mutual Fund - UTI-Nifty Next 50 Exchange Traded Fund is an exchange traded fund co-launched by Life Insurance Corporation of India, Punjab National Bank, State Bank of India, and Bank of Baroda. It is managed by UTI Asset Management Company Limited. The fund invests in the public equity markets of India. It seeks to invest in the stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. The fund invests in the stocks of companies across all market capitalizations. It seeks to replicate the performance of the Nifty Next 50 Index. UTI Mutual Fund - UTI-Nifty Next 50 Exchange Traded Fund was formed on August 4, 2017 and is domiciled in India.
